test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.

options.text: The Great Elephant Uprising: A Cautionary Tale
Monkeying Around: A Tale of Mischief and Pranks
Trouble in the Trees: A Monkey's Mischief

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage revolves around a group of mischievous monkeys playing pranks, especially on the elephants.
 
• The theme of the story is lighthearted mischief, making "Monkeying Around: A Tale of Mischief and Pranks" the most fitting title.
 
• Option 1 and Option 4 also mention the monkeys' antics, but they don't fully capture the overall theme of fun and pranks.
 
• Option 2 is misleading because the story does not focus on an "uprising" by the elephants but rather a playful lesson for the monkeys.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Summary:** *Monkeys played a prank on the elephants, but when the elephants retaliated, the monkeys learned their lesson and decided to prank more harmlessly in the future.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The Banana Bandit's Misadventure"** – While it suggests a prank, the monkeys were not bandits, making it slightly inaccurate.
 
• **Option 2: "The Great Elephant Uprising: A Cautionary Tale"** – The elephants did not stage an uprising, so this title is misleading.
 
• **Option 4: "Trouble in the Trees: A Monkey's Mischief"** – Though accurate, it does not emphasize the prank aspect as well as Option 3.
